small_guidance:
- Add a `triton.autotune` sweep over BLOCK_M ∈ {32,64,128}, BLOCK_N ∈ {32,64,128}, BLOCK_K ∈ {16,32,64}, num_warps ∈ {4,8}, num_stages ∈ {2,3,4}; current 64/64/32 with 4 warps is likely undersized for OC=128, spatial=24·48·48.
- Swap the program axes so `pid_m` (OC tile) and `pid_s` (spatial tile) form the fast 2D grid and put N on axis 0 with `tl.program_id` to improve L2 reuse of weights across the spatial tile; also try grouping spatial+batch into one axis with an L2-swizzle.
- Hoist the `kd/kh/kw` validity computation out of the IC loop (already done) and skip the entire IC loop when `valid` is all-false using `tl.max(valid)`-style early-out via a mask on `acc` accumulation; additionally precompute `in_base` once per (kd,kh,kw) outside the IC loop (it doesn't depend on ic).
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as a scatter-add (input-centric) kernel: one program per `(N, IC tile, input-spatial tile)` computes the `input × weight` outer product `[BLOCK_S, OC]` and scatter-adds into the output grid using `tl.atomic_add`. This avoids the divisibility/branch overhead of the gather formulation and gives KD·KH·KW=27 dense FMAs per input voxel with no wasted lanes. Apply clamp+divide in a tiny separate epilogue kernel over the output (or fuse with the bias add as a final pass).
- Alternatively, keep gather but reformulate as explicit im2col-style GEMM: precompute a single GEMM `[N·OD·OH·OW, OC] = [N·OD·OH·OW, IC·KD·KH·KW] @ [IC·KD·KH·KW, OC]` with implicit indexing, where the K dimension is `IC·KD·KH·KW` (=1728) — one big K-loop with `tl.dot` per BLOCK_K=32 step lets the tensor cores stay saturated rather than 27 separate small dots.
- Use `channels_last_3d` end-to-end (keep input/output in NDHWC, store weight as [KD,KH,KW,IC,OC]) so the GEMM-K stride is contiguous and `tl.dot` issues 128-bit loads; current layout already does NDHWC for activations but weight stride along IC is `KD*KH*KW*OC` which is non-contiguous — transpose weight to put IC innermost on K.
